text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Basri launches first tranche of social priorities programme to be financed by World Bank $260 million loan.
- Prime Minister Filali launches building of highway linking Larache to Sidi Yamani in north.
- With only two women in parliament, feminists hope to get more seats in next elections.
- Moroccan court cuts to two and half years jail terms imposed on two British women, including a pregnant teenager, on drug charges.
- Education ministry prepares study on decentralising management of schools.
- Finance Minister Kabbaj will discuss conversion of debt during visit to Spain on October 24.
